# Zero-Token Wakeup 配置
# 零Token唤醒机制
# 命名空间: NGT-WAKE-v1.0-FIN-260327

version: "1.0"
description: "断电后零Token快速恢复机制"

wakeup:
  # 状态保存（休眠前）
  hibernate:
    trigger:
      - "user_exit"
      - "idle_timeout"
      - "manual_command"
      
    save_content:
      - "session_state"
      - "working_memory"
      - "pending_tasks"
      - "checkpoint_reference"
      
    format: "compressed_binary"
    location: "tier_2_warm_storage"
    encryption: true

  # 唤醒机制
  wakeup:
    detection:
      -
